messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two consenting adults in a new romantic relationship. Keep the affection natural and contemporary. Let attraction coexist with ordinary conversation and small practical details. Avoid idealized language, melodrama, and constant declarations of love.

“You left your jacket here.”

Morgan held it up from the back of the chair.

Casey looked toward the door. “I was wondering why I was cold.”

“You were outside in a T-shirt.”

“I was optimistic.”

“You were freezing.”

Casey walked back across the room to take the jacket.

Morgan kept hold of one sleeve.

“What?” Casey asked.

“Nothing.”

“That face isn't nothing.”

Morgan smiled. “I like you.”

Casey laughed. “You picked now to say that?”

“You're wearing my jacket.”

“That seems like a strange reason.”

“It works for me.”

Casey stepped closer. “Anything else?”

Morgan shook her head.

“No?”

“I'm thinking.”

“Dangerous.”

Morgan smiled and kissed her forehead.

“There.”

Casey touched the spot with two fingers.

“Better.”

“Much.”
